newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end down on excess funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end down on excess funds.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates slipped on Sunday on surplus liquidity and dealers said they were likely to hover at lower levels in the next few sessions.
Overnight funds opened at six percent amid excess funds and soon fell to three percent, with many deals struck at that level, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
Dealers said the market was likely to open liquid on Monday as quite a few lenders had surplus funds at close of trading.
